messages:
Jordan: Quick update 10:00 PT start delayed 3m to let video ingest finish. Roadmap Q&A moved to final 12m block. Recording will be on; please hold long threads for the Q&A doc.
Priya: ack. can we also swap the order: PMs before infra? Infra only needs 45s.
Omar: fine by me. Zoe do the mic check when VideoOps asks?
Zoe: I'll be ready. happy to mute desktop audio and use headset.
VideoOps: Preflight run: captions ON, primary ingest OK, backup ingest present. Recording target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769077777.mp4
StreamBot: Recording started. viewers: 4 (pre).
Zoe: mic check: "Redwood mic test"
Priya: heard loud and clear in preview.
Omar: caption preview shows ~5s lag in apac. Ops?
OpsBot: caption TTL at apac edge ~5s. global TTL ~1-2s. Monitoring.
Jordan: if caption service fails, do not stop the stream; annotate and continue. We'll patch transcript later.
VideoOps: 10:06:12 - OBS logged duplicate audio src; disabling desktop audio for 'All-hands' scene.
StreamBot: Live viewers: 312. Reactions: :clap: :tada:.
Zoe: presenting demo now. viewers reporting audio drop at 10:09. I see an obs warning: `mic_buffer_underrun`.
VideoOps: placing marker at 10:09:02 for audio underrun. Switching to backup ingest at 10:09:14 due to sustained jitter.
StreamBot: ingest switched to backup. Recording continues, new segment appended.
Priya: captions just crashed at 10:11:05 (service error).
OpsBot: captions process exited unexpectedly; auto-restart failed. Failover captions to captions-backend-2 engaged at 10:11:12. Annotation placed.
Jordan: please keep going. Editor will splice captions. Do we have raw audio backups?
VideoOps: enabling raw + mixed audio exports now. EditorBot: adding edit ticket with markers for audio underrun and caption outage.
EditorBot: ticket created: ENG-ALLHANDS-1769077777. Markers: 10:09:02 (audio), 10:11:05-10:11:18 (captions).
Omar: chat Q for leadership: will Dedicated include region pinning for fallbacks? We'll cover in Q&A.
Jordan: yes we'll answer during the roadmap Q&A. keep your questions short during live.
StreamBot: Recording stopped. Uploading file: all-hands-1769077777.mp4.
OpsBot: Upload complete. Transcode in progress. Checksums pending.
VideoOps: transcode reported header mismatch on first segment; reprocessing now.
EditorBot: adding reprocess note to ticket.
Jordan: thanks everyone for quick triage. Retro for stream ops tomorrow 11:15am; please add action items to the board. We'll publish slides + corrected transcript in #general when ready.
